messages:
emma: Quick note from today's bring-up: ran zephyr-7b int6 across GTN longform + checklist slices. Need a short ops/product decision.

charlie: TL;DR numbers pls.

ops-bot: micro summary:
```
model: zephyr-7b
quant: int6
cost/1k: $0.0031
baseline (int8) cost/1k: $0.0054
throughput: +1.7x
slice failure (regression): 2.8% (n=900)
p95 latency: +10ms
```

emma: quality issues mainly list-truncation and occasional entity swaps in the checklist slice. Frequency low but concentrated on high-value prompts (~15% of GTN traffic).

lee: propose hybrid: route checklist slice to int8, keep int6 for everything else. Canary 5% GTN to int6 with shadowing and automated list-length checks.

charlie: economics (100M tokens/day): all-int8 $540/day, all-int6 $310/day, hybrid (85% int6) ~$360/day. Saves ~$180/day vs all-int8.

emma: action items:
- lee: add routing flag `zephyr_int6_gtn_checklist` + fallback to int8 on >2% critical regressions (ETA 1d)
- charlie: run 1k shadow eval + 200 human spots (ETA 48h)
- ops-bot: emit comparator diffs to #eng-ml when ready

charlie: product ok with canary. Keep rollback aggressive if conversion signal degrades.

emma: tagging @oncall for 24h watch during canary. Will reconvene after bench diffs.
